statusMeaning.merged: On main. Every path in files and tests must exist and every prerequisite must also be merged.
statusMeaning.in-review: Complete on a branch with an open pull request; pr names it. Paths are not checked on this branch.
statusMeaning.todo: Not started. Paths are the plan's intent, not a promise about names.
statusMeaning.removed: Withdrawn from the design; the reason is in note.

pipelineV3.scope: Research pipeline "faithful" (faithful-v1), selectable in Settings; current stays default until the LeapEdge comparison. Transcript-only draft (1 Gemini call), deterministic structural preflight, then an independent fidelity check (Sonnet) of each sentence against only the quotes it cites, chunked by 12 and run in parallel within one step; evidence no sentence cites is recorded as missing; no repeated coverage audit or repair loop. A failed chunk withholds its sentences and marks the brief needs_review.
